name: Meiko Network Japan Co., Ltd.
summary: Meiko Network Japan Co., Ltd. provides education services in Japan. It operates individual tutoring cram schools; programming school; soccer schools; Japanese language school; and individual English school instructed by bilinguals. The company also offers childcare and nutrition staffing, digital marketing and DX, university education, university entrance examination, after school, human resource, recruitment, and dispatch services, as well as services related to employment of foreigners. In addition, it engages in the event and travel business, as well as offers career change support for nursery and dietitians. The company was formerly known as Meiko Gijuku Corporation and changed its name to Meiko Network Japan Co., Ltd. in December 1986. Meiko Network Japan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
